children: Pandora has potential for further upgrades to the margin target for next year, RBC Capital Markets' analyst Piral Dadhania says in a note. This will depend on the execution of the company's strategy to implement platinum-plated jewelry, he says. Earlier this year, Pandora said it would start selling platinum-based jewelry as part of a shift away from silver to protect profitability from big swings in precious-metal prices. The Danish jeweler on Wednesday raised its EBIT margin view for the next year to 14%-15% including one-offs and to 15.5%-16.5% excluding one-offs. It had previously anticipated a margin above 12% and more than 14%, respectively. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
